### 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of a roasted chicken drumstick, flatbread, leafy salad, green beans, and sliced vegetables.

### 2 — Vessel
A square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation, its area is **3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm²**. The upper edge is cropped, so estimates concern only visible food.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: chicken drumstick with skin, flatbread, mixed salad leaves, green beans, orange vegetable rounds (likely carrots), and cucumber slices. No distinct sauce or dressing is clearly visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Volumes represent the outer envelope; bulk density is applied once.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = volume | Density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed salad leaves | 24% | 127 × 2.5 = 318 ml | 0.15 | 48 | 20 | 10 |
| Green beans | 9% | 48 × 0.85 = 41 ml | 0.60 | 24 | 35 | 8 |
| Chicken drumstick, edible meat and skin | 11% | 58 × 1.6 = 93 ml | 0.95 | 88 | 215 | 189 |
| Flatbread | 10% | 53 × 0.65 = 34 ml | 0.95 | 33 | 290 | 96 |
| Cooked carrot rounds | 8% | 42 × 1.7 = 72 ml | 0.60 | 43 | 40 | 17 |
| Cucumber slices | 3% | 16 × 0.8 = 13 ml | 0.60 | 8 | 15 | 1 |

**Coverage check:** 24 + 9 + 11 + 10 + 8 + 3 = **65%**, consistent with the substantial exposed plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **244 g of edible food and 320 kcal** is plausible for the visible small drumstick, modest bread portion, and vegetables. Chicken weight excludes the bone. Uncertainty is roughly ±25%, especially for bread thickness and cooking fat.
